title: Tofu Wrap with Slovakian Twist
description: A Mexican-inspired vegan wrap with a unique Slovakian twist. This dish combines the flavors of Mexico with the spices of Slovakia.

ingredients.name: Slovakian oozing sausage
ingredients.notes: Make sure to squeeze out excess oil

ingredients.name: Extra-firm tofu
ingredients.notes: Press tofu for at least 30 minutes before use

ingredients.name: Whole wheat wrap
ingredients.notes: Choose a brand with a 'gluten-free' label

ingredients.name: Mixed greens
ingredients.notes: Add your favorite lettuce, spinach, and other greens

ingredients.name: Diced bell peppers
ingredients.notes: Red, yellow, or orange, whichever you like

ingredients.name: Cilantro
ingredients.notes: Add as much or as little as you like

ingredients.name: Slovakian paprika
ingredients.notes: Add a smoky flavor to your dish

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Add sliced Slovakian oozing sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add crumbled tofu and cook until golden brown, about 4-5 minutes.
Add diced bell peppers and onions and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add mixed greens, chopped cilantro, and Slovakian paprika. Stir to combine.
Wrap the mixture in a whole wheat wrap and slice in half.
Drizzle with lime juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: Add sliced avocado or sour cream for extra creaminess.
